I will buy some fertilizer and improved seed from the market to get a good harvest, and I will spray herbicide because the weeds in rice are too much for my old back to pull by hand. But I have no money for hired workers or irrigation pumps, so my wife and children will do all the work with our own hands, trusting the rains that God sends.
